# Markdown standards corpus

Generated by `scripts/generate-markdown-spec.ts`, with source URLs and SHA-256
checksums pinned in that file:

- `commonmark.lua`: all 652 examples from the
  [CommonMark 0.31.2 specification](https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/),
  Copyright © 2014–2024 John MacFarlane.
- `gfm.lua`: all 28 extension examples from the
  [GFM 0.29-gfm specification](https://github.github.com/gfm/), by John
  MacFarlane and contributors.
- `gfm-additional.lua`: 27 applicable regressions from
  [cmark-gfm's extensions corpus](https://github.com/github/cmark-gfm/blob/27d942c8b0a62d192f616e5bf3578f4b6a89e180/test/extensions.txt),
  by Yuki Izumi and contributors. Footnote-specific examples are excluded
  because footnotes are not a GFM specification extension. The upstream
  `<IGNORE>` case checks successful parsing rather than HTML equality.

These examples are redistributed under
[Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).
Changes from the sources are mechanical conversion to Lua records, extraction
of the GFM extension sections and restoration of displayed tab markers. Example
IDs and section names are preserved. The fixture data retains this license
independently of the repository's software license.

`support.lua` loads the production parser without WoW globals and provides an
HTML writer solely for conformance comparison. That writer handles HTML tag
filtering as an output policy and normalizes equivalent task-checkbox markup;
it is not the addon's renderer.
